Method of Attack: Spamming text messages to contacts stolen from infected devices to spread malware-ridden APKs
Tricking victims into installing malicious apps via fake security update lures
Gaining additional permissions and Android Accessibility service access to hide and execute malicious tasks
Overlaying phishing webview pages on legitimate banking and cryptocurrency apps to steal credentials
Harvesting and exfiltrating address book and SMS messages, monitoring system notifications, making phone calls
Discoverer: New Zealand's computer emergency response team (CERT NZ)
Indicators of Compromise: SMS messages about pending or missed parcel deliveries or stolen photos
Installation pages warning of FluBot infection and prompting fake security updates
Botnet controlling roughly 60,000 devices collecting phone numbers of 25% of Spanish citizens
